Canada Considers Legal Action Over Stelco Layoffs

Canadian Minister of Economic Development, Mélanie Joly, has stated that "everything is on the table" as the government considers legal action against Stelco regarding recent layoffs. The government is contemplating forcing the company to sell its Canadian assets if the layoffs proceed. This potential action comes as Stelco announced job cuts, prompting the government's intervention.
